next.reason: §1985:XIII.3.2.3 SR3: 'File-name-1 may only reference a sequential file.' In 2023 a report file's file control entry is Format 3, which 'shall be specified only for a sequential file or a report file' (§2023:12.4.5.2 SR11) and 'defines a file connector for a sequential file' (§2023:12.4.5.3 GR8); Formats 1 and 2 serve only indexed and relative files (§2023:12.4.5.2 SR8, SR9), whose file description entry is Format 2 (§2023:13.4.5.3 SR7), not the report Format 3 (§2023:13.4.5.3 SR8). A report file stays sequential; refusals stay compile-time.
